releases.notes:
## Which jar do I download?

Install **one** addon jar alongside its matching AUTISM Client:

| Jar | AUTISM Client | Addon API |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `autism-base-finding-tools-3.0.0.jar` | V4 / `5.1-26.2` (current official) | v4 |
| `autism-base-finding-tools-3.0.0+client5.0.jar` | `5.0-26.2` (public release) | v3 |

Requires Minecraft **26.2**, Java **25+**, Fabric Loader **0.19.3+** and compatible Fabric API. Do not install both variants together.

## Changes




New modules are opt-in. Home Setter SET mode, the separate Relog Loader workflow, seed cracking and unrelated addon features remain available. The README contains the full source-to-module mapping.

## Validation and limits

- Both variants passed **643 automated tests**.
- Isolated offline checks on both hosts confirmed **27/27 port registrations**, **11/11 new/modified mixins**, and normal **exit code 0** without a shutdown watchdog.
- The release archives contain the same compiled classes, resources and nested dependencies as the runtime-tested builds; only the mod-version value in `fabric.mod.json` differs.
- Active module gameplay was not authenticated or live-server tested. Detection results are clues, not proof of bases or vanished players. Movement/mining behavior is server-dependent; no bypass or anti-cheat immunity is guaranteed.
- API3 may log a handled optional AI-bridge-unavailable notice. AI features still require the supported AI-enabled host.

## Which jar do I download?

Install **one** jar that matches your AUTISM Client:

| Jar | AUTISM Client | API |
|-----|---------------|-----|
| `autism-base-finding-tools-2.4.5.jar` | **V4 / 5.1-26.2** (current official) | v4 |
| `autism-base-finding-tools-2.4.5+client5.0.jar` | **5.0-26.2** (public release) | v3 |

## Highlights

- **Guarded Base Scout:** optional bounded walking exploration coordinates existing finders, stops on safety or automation conflicts, and keeps candidate evidence locally for manual review. It is not a survival guarantee or proof of a base.
- **Finder improvements:** Classic and Dog+ Sus Chunk modes; optional settled mined-geode candidates; Player Finder light-data/simulation modes; underground light detection; and revised chunk/stash candidate reporting. These remain investigative signals, not confirmed player locations.
- **Chat Games:** 316 bundled trivia questions, expanded local puzzle solving and a client-editable 489-entry curated default word/phrase list. Existing saved additions are retained. The large English fallback and live Minecraft/world registry words remain automatic.
- **Chat Bot / AI:** uses the selected V4 language-model provider for conversations, separates replies from owner-only game actions, and adds an optional authenticated local AI-control bridge.
- **Automation / trading:** GoTo/Gather/Elytra/inventory coordination, screen-aware navigation, safer AH Sniper confirmation and price checks, stricter AH Sell inventory filtering, and validated Panic Pay acknowledgements.
- **Documentation and validation:** module groups, setup/safety/known limitations, chat-game data sources and Base Scout evidence review are documented in README and `docs/`.

Both jars were built from the same source revision. Full build/test result: **API v4 / Client 5.1 - 404 tests passed; API v3 / Client 5.0 - 401 passed, 3 V4-host-specific tests skipped.**

Base-finding results are hypotheses and need manual inspection. Base Scout and other automated movement can still be stopped by server rules, hazards, combat tags, client stalls or network failures; no survival or anticheat-safety guarantee is made.

releases.notes:
## Which jar do I download?

| Jar | AUTISM Client | API |
|-----|---------------|-----|
| `autism-base-finding-tools-2.4.4.jar` | **V4 / 5.1** (current official) | v4 |
| `autism-base-finding-tools-2.4.4+client5.0.jar` | **5.0** (public release) | v3 |

## Fixes
- **AH buying actually completes**: the purchase-confirm dialog was misdetected (a 27-slot confirm screen was read as a listing page, and the lore check deadlocked every confirm). Purchases now detect the confirm GUI by container slots + screen title, re-verify seller/count/full price/enchantments before clicking, and match the confirm button by name/id (never a red/cancel item, and a lime-pane target no longer skips its own confirm button). Unconfirmed purchases stop the sniper instead of blind-retrying.
- **AH Flipper optional auto-buy** (default OFF): buy sales-backed flips through the sniper's verified executor. Requires a positive Buy budget; ask-only estimates stay alerts; attempts reserve their full price even if unconfirmed; default 1 attempt per enable. Bulk settings reset / container close cancels a pending buy safely. Stale flip alerts fixed (rank cache now invalidates on book changes).
- **Storage Recorder clear keybind**: optional key (Record group, unbound by default) that runs the same Clear action - only during gameplay, one press = one clear. Cleared positions stay hidden until a loaded chunk proves them gone or the session ends.
- **Region Map image loads**: the built-in map now resolves from the addon's own asset namespace; custom PNG failures fall back to the built-in map and warn once instead of every frame.
- Price parsing hardened: BigDecimal k/m/b/t amounts (no double overflow), lore-only reading, enchanted books read stored enchantments.

Both jars built from the same source revision; full 233-test suite green on each (5.1/API4 and 5.0/API3).

## Fixes
- **.goto no longer crashes/freezes the game**: chunk scanning is budgeted (48 chunks/pass, nearest-first), disk writes moved off the game thread, and the chunk cache is capped at 2048 chunks with distance-based eviction - far goals (2000+ blocks) no longer OOM.
- **Addon tabs are now separate**: modules are grouped into their own GUI tabs (Dogs Fake / Trading / Render / Entity / Finders / Movement etc.) instead of one giant tab. Works on the official obfuscated 5.1 client.
- .goto "no path" hint now shows the full `.goto mine x y z` syntax.

## New
- **Parkour module** (utility tab): auto-jumps at block edges while you run - no key timing needed. "Only while moving" setting included.

Tested in-game on AUTISM Client 5.1-26.2: goto far-target, freeze watch, disable stability, parkour edge-jump, tab grouping (12 separate Dogs tabs confirmed), module smoke tests - all PASS.

releases.notes:
## Removed the buggy TunnelBase Finder and replaced it

The old TunnelBase Finder's XENON and WALK_2X1 modes were flagging the anti-cheat (rubber-bands / setbacks on live DonutSMP). Both modes are **gone**. `TunnelBase Finder` is now a single clean toggle that runs the proven Water engine - the mode that doesn't flag.

### Changes
- **TunnelBase Finder**: rewritten as a thin hand-off to the Water engine (1900+ lines of flaggy dig logic deleted). Just toggle it on and it drives Tunnel Base (Water).
- **45-degree diagonal detours**: when the tunnel needs to dodge a lake, it now makes ONE turn to ~45 degrees, cuts diagonally past the hazard, then ONE turn back - instead of the old 90-degree staircase that turned the camera at every lake edge.
- **Hazard overhaul (Water engine)**:
  - Lava survival reflex: if you end up IN lava, everything stops, you float + back out, then re-route on the other side.
  - Forward scan now also catches dry drops (>3 blocks = fall damage / cave fall) and magma/contact-hazard floors, not just fluids.
  - Tower (climb-over) scan checks the shaft's side pockets for fluids at every level it will open - no more gravel/lava dumps mid-climb.
  - Commit-lock emergency brake: a committed turn re-checks point-blank and re-decides if a flow front moved in.
  - Deep-clear lanes are preferred over short-scan lanes when picking a detour side.
  - Base scan throttled to every 10 ticks (big CPU win at high render distance).
- **New icon.**

### Install
Drop `autism-seedcracker-1.9.3.jar` in your mods folder next to the AUTISM Client 5.0 base jar. Delete any older addon jar.

releases.notes:
## v1.9.1

### Movement overhaul (Tunnel Base Water + Xenon/Walk)
- **Water is now the default tunnel mode** - Tunnel Base Finder hands off to the Water engine
- Fixed bedrock lava box-in: towering up only checks the ceiling now
- Fixed tower dig phase digging DOWN toward lava (pitch bug)
- Position-verified towering with computed target height + stall watchdogs
- Go AROUND lava (sticky side detours with resume hysteresis) - no more turning back over loaded chunks, no more back-and-forth second-guessing
- Xenon: fixed avoidance cooldown freezing forever after the first hazard (the lag-back/bug-out root cause), proper converged-aim digging, cave-abort escalation, legit pillar escape
- Auto-eat: eats ANY food, earlier trigger, never stalls mining when out of food
- Base flag now REQUIRES a spawner by default (require-spawner setting)
- Full key-release hygiene across all movement modules (no stuck strafe/sneak/use keys)

### New
- **Scoreboard Hider** (Render) - render-only sidebar hide, undetectable

### Fixes
- Chunk Waypoints: markers are now ALWAYS pinned at the set Y (removed the follow-below option entirely - stale configs were re-enabling it)
- SpawnerProtect: storage state machine actually opens the shulker before filling; sneak released during storage
- AutoEat: no more double-fire use packets; survives GUI opens mid-bite
